findings.quote: In sleep mode, the controller shall draw less than 100 µA from the 12 V supply.
findings.explanation: This is word for word the same as WLC-032. Keep one copy so the requirement is tested and traced only once.
findings.rewrite: In sleep mode, the controller shall draw less than 100 µA from the 12 V supply. (Keep this one and delete WLC-032.)

findings.quote: for 45 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first
findings.explanation: WLC-023 allows movement for 60 s after ignition off, but this requirement allows 45 s and also ends it when a front door is opened. Both cannot be met.
findings.rewrite: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for [TBD: agreed time, 45 s or 60 s] or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first. (Delete WLC-023.)

findings.explanation: "Quickly" cannot be measured. The requirement also does not say when rain closing is allowed (for example after ignition off) or that anti-pinch must stay active during it.
findings.rewrite: When the rain sensor reports rain, the controller shall start closing the window within [TBD: maximum reaction time] and close it to fully closed, with anti-pinch protection active as in WLC-014 to WLC-016.

findings.quote: Anti-pinch protection shall be disabled when the controller is not normalized.
findings.explanation: WLC-016 says anti-pinch is active in manual mode, but manual closing is still allowed when not normalized (WLC-013, WLC-022). This requirement switches anti-pinch off in that case, so the two contradict each other, and this is also a safety gap.
findings.rewrite: When the controller is not normalized, the controller shall allow closing only in manual mode, with anti-pinch protection [TBD: behaviour when not normalized, e.g. active using a fallback detection method, or closing allowed only while the switch is held, per safety analysis].

findings.explanation: "All disturbances" cannot be listed or tested, and "robust" has no pass criterion.
findings.rewrite: The anti-pinch function shall not detect a false pinch, and shall still detect a pinch as in WLC-014, under [TBD: list of disturbances, e.g. rough-road vibration profile, door slam, supply ripple, icing] with [TBD: pass criteria].

findings.explanation: WLC-007 allows 45 s and ends movement when a front door is opened. This requirement allows 60 s with no door condition.
findings.rewrite: Delete this requirement and keep the single agreed after-run time in WLC-007 ([TBD: agreed time]).

findings.quote: exceeds the limit, the controller shall reduce motor current to a safe value
findings.explanation: Neither the temperature limit nor the safe current value is given, so there is nothing to test against. It also needs to be clear how this limit relates to the 140 °C threshold in WLC-026.
findings.rewrite: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds [TBD: temperature limit in °C], the controller shall limit motor current to [TBD: current in A] or less.

findings.explanation: This has two "shall"s (store the DTC and stop the motor), which should be tested and traced separately. It also gives no time for stopping the motor.
findings.rewrite: WLC-029a: The controller shall store DTC B1A01 when the Hall sensor signal is missing for more than 200 ms while the motor is driven. WLC-029b: When the Hall sensor signal is missing for more than 200 ms while the motor is driven, the controller shall stop the motor within [TBD: stop time].

findings.quote: and shall stop the motor and shall set the fault state in WLC_Status
findings.explanation: There are three "shall"s (store the DTC, stop the motor, set the fault state), which should be tested separately. No stop time is given.
findings.rewrite: WLC-030a: The controller shall store DTC B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms. WLC-030b: Under that condition the controller shall stop the motor within [TBD: stop time]. WLC-030c: Under that condition the controller shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.

findings.quote: In sleep mode, the controller shall draw less than 100 µA from the 12 V supply.
findings.explanation: This is word for word the same as WLC-004.
findings.rewrite: Delete this requirement; it is covered by WLC-004.

findings.explanation: "User friendly" cannot be measured or verified.
findings.rewrite: [TBD: specific usability criteria, e.g. switch operating behaviour, feedback, response times], or delete this requirement if WLC-006 to WLC-009 already cover it.

findings.quote: The software shall be developed according to the company software process.
findings.explanation: This is about how the software is developed, not about how the product behaves. It cannot be checked by testing the controller.
findings.rewrite: Move to the project development plan: "WLC-200 software shall be developed according to [TBD: process document ID and version]."

cost_note: Worked out from token counts at base input prices
